def new_transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors={v for row in grid for v in row}
    bg=max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    obj_colors=[v for v in colors if v not in (bg,0)]
    # The marker is the uncommon non-background, nonzero color.
    color=min(obj_colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    sh=max(r for r,c in shape); sw=max(c for r,c in shape)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh):
        for c in range(w-sw):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
                if (r,c)!=(r0,c0):
                    for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=color
                return out
    return out

code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid)
              for value in {cell for row in grid for cell in row}}
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marker = min((value for value in counts if value not in (background, 0)),
                 key=counts.get)

    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
              for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r, c in points]
    shape_h = max(r for r, c in shape)
    shape_w = max(c for r, c in shape)

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h - shape_h):
        for c in range(w - shape_w):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:
                    out[r + dr][c + dc] = marker
    return out
'''
